fullPassage:
"To grow into a better version of ourselves, we should not stay as we are." That was the first thing our teacher said to us on the first day of school. She wanted us to start the semester by pushing ourselves out of our comfort zones and learning more about ourselves. To help us do so, she gave us an assignment to challenge ourselves in three different ways. The three challenges could involve hobbies, exercise, our studies, or even our relationships. The important part was trying something new for each one. She told us that we should share our experiences with our classmates when we finished the challenges.

Challenge 1: Ticket for One
These days, I tend to watch movies on streaming services. However, if I go to the theater, I usually watch an action or science fiction movie with my friends or family. Those are the kinds of movies they enjoy. Going to the theater alone was something I had never done before. So, for the first challenge, I decided to give it a try. It was nice to choose the movie and the seat on my own. I didn't have to worry about anyone else's preferences. I saw the experience as a good opportunity to watch something different, so I chose a historical drama that I had been curious about. At first, it felt a bit awkward and lonely to sit in the theater by myself. But once the movie started, I became completely absorbed in the story. It was so satisfying just to focus on the movie itself. There was nothing to distract me! This experience made me realize that I sometimes enjoy doing things alone. After the movie, I promised myself that I would try to make my own choices more often and enjoy more activities by myself in the future.

Challenge 2: Riding the Waves
Ever since I was a child, I've always been afraid of water. So I have never enjoyed water activities or felt comfortable while doing them. For the second challenge, I decided to try to overcome this discomfort. However, I wasn't sure what to do at first. One day, I came across a video clip of my cousin surfing at an indoor pool on social media. It looked fun, and I liked the fact that it took place in a shallow pool, not in the ocean. I messaged my cousin about it. She assured me that it wasn't too hard, so I signed up for a beginner course. At the beginning of the lesson, it was hard just to stand up on the board. After some help from the instructor, however, I learned how to balance properly and even managed to surf a few waves! It gave me such a rush of excitement. Being in the water wasn't as bad as I had thought. While the experience didn't completely change my mind about water sports, it did help me discover my sense of adventure.

Challenge 3: A New Look
Of all the challenges I chose for myself, the third one made me the most nervous: changing my hairstyle. For many years, I had kept the same hairstyle because I had been worried about my forehead. I had always thought it was large, and I didn't want to draw attention to it. Since I was feeling confident after the first two challenges, I went to a hair salon and talked to the stylist. He listened to my concerns and helped me find a shorter hairstyle that suited me. The next day at school, my classmates were a bit surprised. But overall, the reactions were positive. I realized that trying a different look wasn't as difficult as I thought it would be. In fact, it made me feel more confident about myself. I didn't expect that stepping out of my comfort zone would have such a positive effect on how I felt about myself.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 그녀는 우리에게 세 가지 다른 방식으로 우리 자신에게 도전(challenge)하라는 과제를 주었다. 다른 사람의 취향(preferences)에 대해 걱정할 필요가 없었다. 나는 그 경험을 다른 무언가를 볼 수 있는 좋은 기회(opportunity)로 여겼다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② challenge — preferences — opportunity: 원문 일치
❌ ① comfort: '도전하다'가 아닌 '편안하게 하다'
❌ ③ complaints: '취향'이 아닌 '불만'
❌ ④ comfort: challenge가 맞는 표현
det.tip: challenge(도전하다) ↔ comfort(편안하게 하다), preferences(취향/선호) ↔ complaints(불만), opportunity(기회) ↔ obstacle(장애물)

det.korean: 물 활동을 하면서 편안함(comfortable)을 느낀 적이 없었다. 이 불편함을 극복(overcome)하기로 결심했다. 그것은 나에게 흥분(excitement)의 전율을 주었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① comfortable — overcome — excitement: 원문 일치
❌ ② disappointment: 흥분이 아닌 실망
❌ ③ anxious: comfortable의 반의어
❌ ④ accept: overcome과 대조적 의미
det.tip: comfortable(편안한) ↔ anxious(불안한), overcome(극복하다) ↔ accept(수용하다), excitement(흥분) ↔ disappointment(실망)

det.korean: 세 번째 도전은 나를 가장 긴장(nervous)하게 만들었다. 반응은 전반적으로 긍정적(positive)이었다. 다른 모습을 시도하는 것이 내가 생각한 것만큼 어렵지(difficult) 않았다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ nervous — positive — difficult: 원문 일치
❌ ① negative: positive의 반의어
❌ ② excited: nervous가 아닌 신남
❌ ④ simple: difficult의 반의어
det.tip: nervous(긴장된) ↔ excited(신나는), positive(긍정적) ↔ negative(부정적), difficult(어려운) ↔ simple(간단한)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 물에 있는 것이 내가 생각한 것만큼 나쁘지(bad) 않았다. ③ pleasant(즐거운)은 원문 bad의 반의어로, 'wasn't as pleasant'로 바뀌면 문맥이 어색해진다. 원문 'wasn't as bad'는 '생각보다 나쁘지 않았다(=괜찮았다)'는 긍정적 의미인데, 'wasn't as pleasant'는 '생각보다 즐겁지 않았다'는 부정적 의미가 되어 글의 흐름과 모순된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① shallow: 얕은 — 원문 일치
✅ ② balance: 균형을 잡다 — 원문 일치
❌ ③ pleasant: 원문은 bad (wasn't as bad = 나쁘지 않았다 → wasn't as pleasant = 즐겁지 않았다 → 문맥 모순)
✅ ④ discover: 발견하다 — 원문 일치
det.tip: wasn't as bad as I had thought = 생각보다 나쁘지 않았다 (긍정적). pleasant로 바꾸면 부정적 의미가 되어 서핑을 즐긴 문맥과 모순.

det.korean: 오랫동안 이마에 대해 걱정했었다(worried). ③ indifferent(무관심한)은 원문 worried의 반의어로 부적절하다.

✅ ② adventure: 모험 — 원문 일치

✅ ④ attention: 관심/주의 — 원문 일치
det.tip: worried(걱정하는) ↔ indifferent(무관심한)

det.korean: 영화 자체에만 집중하는 것은 매우 만족스러웠다(satisfying). ④ disappointing(실망스러운)은 원문 satisfying의 반의어로 부적절하다.

❌ ① disappointed: 실망한 — 문맥과 불일치

❌ ③ praises: 칭찬 — 이마 걱정 맥락과 불일치
❌ ④ jokes: 농담 — 문맥과 불일치
det.tip: concerns = worries (걱정/우려). 이마에 대한 걱정을 스타일리스트에게 말한 상황.

❌ ③ excuse: 변명 — 무관

det.analysis:
✅ ④ saw ~ as: '~로 여기다/간주하다' 의미
❌ ①②③ saw: '보다(see)'의 과거형
det.tip: see A as B = regard A as B (A를 B로 여기다). see의 다의어: ① 보다 ② 이해하다 ③ ~로 여기다

questions.passage: Of all the challenges I chose for myself, the third one made me the most nervous: changing my hairstyle. For many years, I had kept the same hairstyle because I had been worried about my forehead. I had always thought it was large, and I didn't want to draw attention to it. Since I was feeling confident after the first two challenges, I went to a hair salon and talked to the stylist.
questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 단어가 나머지 셋과 다른 의미로 쓰인 것은?
ch: The artist will draw a portrait.
I didn't want to draw attention to it.
She asked him to draw a picture.

det.korean: ② draw attention = 주의를 끌다 (attract), 나머지 = 그리다
det.analysis:
✅ ② draw attention: '(주의를) 끌다' 의미
❌ ①③④ draw: '그리다' 의미
det.tip: draw의 다의어: ① 그리다 ② (관심을) 끌다 ③ 뽑다 ④ 가까이 다가가다. draw attention to = 주의를 끌다

questions.passage: At first, it felt a bit awkward and lonely to sit in the theater by myself. But once the movie started, I became (complete) ______ absorbed in the story. It was so satisfying just to focus on the movie itself. There was nothing to distract me! This experience made me realize that I sometimes enjoy doing things alone. After the movie, I promised myself that I would try to make my own choices more often and enjoy more activities by myself in the future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: 영화가 시작되자, 나는 이야기에 완전히(completely) 몰입했다.
det.analysis: complete(형용사) → completely(부사): 동사 absorbed를 수식하므로 부사형이 필요
det.tip: 형용사 → 부사 변환: complete → completely. 동사/형용사를 수식할 때 부사를 사용.

questions.passage: After some help from the instructor, however, I learned how to balance (proper) ______ and even managed to surf a few waves! It gave me such a rush of excitement. Being in the water wasn't as bad as I had thought. While the experience didn't completely change my mind about water sports, it did help me discover my sense of adventure.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: 강사의 도움 후, 나는 적절하게(properly) 균형을 잡는 법을 배웠다.
det.analysis: proper(형용사) → properly(부사): 동사 balance를 수식하므로 부사형이 필요
det.tip: 형용사 → 부사 변환: proper → properly. '어떻게 균형을 잡았는가'를 설명하므로 부사.

questions.passage: At first, it felt a bit awkward and lonely to sit in the theater by myself. But once the movie started, I became completely absorbed in the story. It was so satisfying just to focus on the movie itself. There was nothing to distract me! This experience made me realize that I sometimes enjoy doing things alone. After the movie, I promised myself that I would try to make my own choices more often and ______ in the future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: avoid being alone at all costs

det.korean: 나는 앞으로 나만의 선택을 더 자주 하고, 혼자서 더 많은 활동을 즐기겠다고 다짐했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ enjoy more activities by myself: 혼자 활동을 즐기겠다는 다짐 — 문맥 일치
❌ ① avoid being alone: 혼자 즐기는 것을 깨달은 내용과 반대
❌ ② follow friends' opinions: 자기 선택을 하겠다는 내용과 반대
❌ ④ stop going to the theater: 극장 경험이 긍정적이었으므로 반대
det.tip: 빈칸 앞 'make my own choices more often and'에서 병렬구조(and) 뒤에 올 내용을 추론. 혼자서도 즐긴다는 깨달음이 핵심.

questions.passage: Of all the challenges I chose for myself, the third one made me the most nervous: changing my hairstyle. For many years, I had kept the same hairstyle because I had been worried about my forehead. I had always thought it was large, and I didn't want to draw attention to it. Since I was feeling confident after the first two challenges, I went to a hair salon and talked to the stylist. He listened to my concerns and helped me find a shorter hairstyle that suited me. The next day at school, my classmates were a bit surprised. But overall, the reactions were positive. I realized that trying a different look wasn't as difficult as I thought it would be. In fact, it made me feel more confident about myself. I didn't expect that ______.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: my classmates would dislike my new look
stepping out of my comfort zone would have such a positive effect on how I felt about myself
I would regret changing my hairstyle
keeping the same hairstyle was the best decision

det.korean: 안전 영역 밖으로 나가는 것이 내 자신에 대한 감정에 이토록 긍정적인 효과를 줄 줄 몰랐다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② stepping out of my comfort zone would have such a positive effect: 원문의 결론과 일치
❌ ① classmates would dislike: 반응이 긍정적이었다는 내용과 반대
❌ ③ regret changing: 자신감이 생겼다는 내용과 반대
❌ ④ keeping the same: 변화가 긍정적이었다는 내용과 반대
det.tip: 글의 결론부: comfort zone을 벗어나는 것의 긍정적 효과. 'I didn't expect that ~'에서 예상 밖의 긍정적 결과를 서술.
